summary.en: Expand the character library to 30 with 18 original portraits, searchable profiles and twelve distinct cast members per game.
summary.zh: 人物库扩为三十人，新增十八张原创肖像、可搜索人物档案，每局抽取十二位不同人物。

reason: Explain cast sampling, character versus secret role, behavioral limits and artwork provenance.

compatibility.en: Seat count remains twelve. Restored games retain their saved character mapping; new character-cast games sample without replacement. Secret roles remain independent.
compatibility.zh: 座位数仍为十二，恢复保留已保存人物映射；新人物对局不重复抽取，秘密身份独立分配。
